shortDescription: Gather information about DHCP scopes in Micetro

options.name: format_options
options.description: Whether to include DHCP scope options in the response.

options.name: gather_options
options.description: Whether to include DHCP scope options in the response.

options.name: limit
options.description: Maximum number of DHCP scopes to return. Must be a positive integer.

options.name: mm_provider
options.description: Configuration details for connecting to the Micetro API.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the DHCP scope to filter by (optional). If not provided, all scopes matching other criteria are returned.

options.name: search_method
options.description: Method to use when filtering by name. C(exact) matches the exact name, C(contains) matches any part, C(starts_with) matches the beginning, C(ends_with) matches the end.

options.name: sort_by
options.description: Field to sort the results by.

options.name: sort_order
options.description: Order in which to sort the results.
